title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
title_zh: 学会做什么，还是学会怎么做？分解智能体训练中的任务能力与接口能力
abstract_en: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.
abstract_zh: LLM 智能体通过运行框架（harness）与环境交互，由框架规定系统提示、动作格式、反馈循环和资源约束。模型即使知道如何解题，也可能无法通过特定框架把解法付诸行动。论文据此区分任务能力（task competence，即解题所需的知识与推理能力）和接口能力（interface competence，即通过给定框架运用这些知识的能力）。在四项推理与智能体基准上的实验表明，多框架蒸馏（multi-harness distillation）能将不同框架下采集的轨迹所含的任务知识整合到同一策略中，但只有保留或提升推理时所用接口的操作能力，这些知识才能转化为实际表现。单框架蒸馏则可能损害其他接口上的能力，即使任务知识有所增长，也可能导致模型在训练未使用的框架上性能骤降。为分离两类监督，作者提出框架演练（harness rehearsal）：用几乎不含任务知识、但能练习目标接口的轨迹进行蒸馏。在 BFCL V3 多轮任务上，Qwen3-4B 仅用跨框架任务监督或仅做框架演练时，成绩分别为 8.5% 和 32.5%，联合使用则达到 58.8%。相比蒸馏，同策略强化学习（on-policy RL）在单框架训练中对其他框架的影响更小，也能保留先前通过多框架蒸馏获得的接口能力。
key_points_zh: 智能体在某个框架下失败，不一定是不会解题，也可能是不会通过该接口执行解法。
多框架蒸馏可汇集任务知识，但知识能否迁移到实际表现，取决于模型是否保有推理所用接口的能力；单框架蒸馏甚至可能使其他框架上的性能骤降。
框架演练用几乎不含任务知识的轨迹训练目标接口。在 BFCL V3 多轮任务上，Qwen3-4B 仅用跨框架任务监督得 8.5%，仅做框架演练得 32.5%，两者结合得 58.8%。
实验中，单框架 on-policy RL 未显著降低其他框架上的表现，也保留了多框架蒸馏学到的接口能力。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 用验证通过的交互轨迹更新共享智能体策略。目标接口演练与跨接口任务蒸馏的 2×2 消融表明，两种监督结合优于单独使用；多接口蒸馏也缓解了留出接口上的性能崩塌，但不保证超过基座。改进发生在策略参数，而非训练框架或改进机制本身。
